path_label_semantics.FAST_ACCEPTANCE: Target acceptance appeared very early after entry.
path_label_semantics.SLOW_ACCEPTANCE: Target acceptance developed gradually without dominant early choppiness.
path_label_semantics.CHOP_THEN_ACCEPTANCE: Material oscillation or sideways action preceded target acceptance.
path_label_semantics.OTHER_WIN_PATH: Positive completed outcome without a clear target-acceptance path, generally an H20 time stop.
